Identity.title: Anonymized multi-interface static candidate from a non-validated conversion

required_effects: For each enabled flow, independently establish actual required external effects from the private configuration and authorized test fixtures.
forbidden_effects: Never infer completed migration or conformance solely from generated components, enabled flags or presumed functional intent.

cases.scenario: An enabled source receives a syntactically valid synthetic payload.
cases.expected: All required logical destinations and observable side effects must be specified and independently checked.

cases.scenario: An input fails the source acceptance rule.
cases.expected: Rejection, acknowledgement and forbidden side effects must be independently established.

cases.scenario: An external dependency fails or times out.
cases.expected: Retries, queueing, persistence and terminal status must be specified and verified for each implementation.

cases.scenario: A generated component requires manual completion.
cases.expected: The result remains NOT_DEMONSTRATED until implementation and execution evidence exists.

cases.scenario: Multiple destinations produce external side effects.
cases.expected: Ordering and completion criteria must be defined independently of both implementation paradigms.

cases.scenario: A flow has no unambiguous implementation provenance match.
cases.expected: The conversion relationship remains unresolved; no success or failure is inferred.

KnownLimitations: No equality or equivalence between ESB-A and ESB-B was stated or demonstrated.
ESB-B is a conversion-generated configuration, not an independent verified implementation.
All original names, scripts, queries, endpoints, identifiers, credentials and templates remain private.
The candidate does not implement portable rule expressions or complete transformations.
The candidate has one or more unresolved provenance matches and manual action flags.
The generator-declared action counts have not been independently completed or verified.
A valid JSON structure cannot prove any functional, security or privacy conformance.
Semantic matching of destinations and reachable components requires deeper flow analysis.
